run_review_app_server: run the review_app_cli command to launch a local Flask review server on a specified host and port
run_review_app_debug: run the review_app_cli command with the debug flag enabled for extra logging and auto-reload
run_review_app_skip_build: run the review_app_cli command with skip-build to launch the server without rebuilding the React UI
run_review_app_force_rebuild: run the review_app_cli command with force-rebuild to rebuild the React bundle before starting the server
run_review_app_custom_host_port: run the review_app_cli command with custom host and port options to serve the review app on a different address
